name: CAD Digital
launchPhaseDetail: LAUNCHED May 4 — Canada's first CAD-backed stablecoin issued by a financial institution; ~530K CADD circulating on Ethereum + Base; now also deployed on Tempo (contract address TBA); backers include Shopify, National Bank of Canada, ATB Financial, Wealthsimple, Shakepay; Baker Tilly monthly attestations live; CoinGecko still zero price/supply, DefiLlama detail endpoint has data but aggregate list does not; PROMOTION CANDIDATE pending aggregator coverage
collateral: Canadian dollar reserves held 1:1 in trust for token holders by Tetra Trust
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption of CADD for CAD through CAD Digital's regulated issuance framework

milestones.title: CADD officially launches as Canada's first regulated CAD-backed stablecoin
milestones.description: Tetra Digital Group launches CADD with backing from Shopify, National Bank of Canada, ATB Financial, Wealthsimple, Shakepay, Purpose Unlimited, and Urbana Corporation; deployed on Ethereum, Base, and Tempo.

featuredContent.title: Shopify and National Bank of Canada Are Among Backers of a New Digital Currency
featuredContent.description: Canada's first regulated CAD-backed stablecoin launches with backing from Shopify, National Bank of Canada, Wealthsimple, and others.

notices.title: Active coverage pending
notices.message: CADD launched May 4, 2026 but remains excluded from active runtime surfaces until CoinGecko or DefiLlama publishes usable live price and supply data.
